2027-07-03.title: Saint Thomas, Apostle
readings: You are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone
Go out to all the world and tell the Good News
2027-07-03.verse: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said to him, “Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe.”

2027-07-04.title: Fourteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: They shall know that there has been a prophet among them
Our eyes are fixed on the Lord, pleading for his mercy
My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness
Prophets are not without honor, except in their hometown
2027-07-04.verse: “Prophets are not without honor, except in their hometown, and among their own kin, and in their own house.” And he could do no deed of power there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and cured them.

2027-07-11.title: Fifteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: The Lord took me from following the flock, and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel’
Lord, let us see your kindness, and grant us your salvation
He chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world
He called the twelve and began to send them out two by two
2027-07-11.verse: So they went out and proclaimed that all should repent. They cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many who were sick and cured them.

2027-07-15.title: Saint Bonaventure, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
readings: I AM has sent me to you
Remember the wonderful works he has done
Come to me, all you that are weary and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest
2027-07-15.verse: Come to me, all you that are weary and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

2027-07-18.title: Sixteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: I will raise up shepherds over them who will shepherd them
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want
He is our peace; he has made both groups into one
He had compassion for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd
2027-07-18.verse: As he went ashore, he saw a great crowd; and he had compassion for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

2027-07-25.title: Seventeenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: They shall eat and have some left
The hand of the Lord feeds us; he answers all our needs
One Lord, one faith, one baptism
Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed them to those who were seated
2027-07-25.verse: Then Jesus took the loaves, and when he had given thanks, he distributed them to those who were seated; so also the fish, as much as they wanted.

2027-07-01.title: Thursday of the Thirteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: God himself will provide the lamb for a burnt offering, my son
Not to us, O Lord, but to your name give glory
Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven
2027-07-01.verse: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”

2027-07-02.title: Friday of the Thirteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Isaac loved Rebekah, and was comforted after his mother's death
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good
2027-07-02.verse: “Go and learn what this means, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have come to call not the righteous but sinners.”

2027-07-05.title: Monday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God
My God, in whom I trust
If I only touch his cloak, I will be made well
2027-07-05.verse: Then Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “Surely the Lord is in this place—and I did not know it!” And he was afraid, and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.”

2027-07-06.title: Tuesday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: You have striven with God and with humans, and have prevailed
I shall behold your face in righteousness
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few
2027-07-06.verse: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd. Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few; therefore ask the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.”

2027-07-07.title: Wednesday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Go to Joseph; what he says to you, do
Truly the eye of the Lord is on those who fear him
As you go, proclaim the good news, ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near’
2027-07-07.verse: As you go, proclaim the good news, ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near.’

2027-07-08.title: Thursday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt
He had sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave
You received without payment; give without payment
2027-07-08.verse: Cure the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. You received without payment; give without payment.

2027-07-09.title: Friday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions, Martyrs
readings: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also bring you up again
The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord
I am sending you out like sheep into the midst of wolves
2027-07-09.verse: See, I am sending you out like sheep into the midst of wolves; so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.

2027-07-10.title: Saturday of the Fourteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: God intended it for good, in order to preserve a numerous people
Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually
So do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows
2027-07-10.verse: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father. And even the hairs of your head are all counted. So do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.

2027-07-12.title: Monday of the Fifteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: A new king arose over Egypt, who did not know Joseph
Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth
2027-07-12.verse: Those who find their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake will find it.

2027-07-13.title: Tuesday of the Fifteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Henry
readings: She named him Moses, “because I drew him out of the water”
You who seek God, let your hearts revive
Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida!
2027-07-13.verse: When the child grew up, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and she took him as her son. She named him Moses, “because,” she said, “I drew him out of the water.”

2027-07-14.title: Wednesday of the Fifteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Camillus de Lellis
readings: Remove the sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground
The Lord works vindication and justice for all who are oppressed
You have hidden these things from the wise and have revealed them to infants
2027-07-14.verse: Then he said, “Come no closer! Remove the sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground.” He said further, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.”

2027-07-16.title: Friday of the Fifteenth Week in Ordinary Time · Our Lady of Mount Carmel
readings: When I see the blood, I will pass over you
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord
I desire mercy and not sacrifice
2027-07-16.verse: Elijah went up to the top of Carmel … At the seventh time he said, “Look, a little cloud no bigger than a person’s hand is rising out of the sea.”

2027-07-17.title: Saturday of the Fifteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: That was for the Lord a night of vigil, to bring them out of the land of Egypt
His steadfast love endures for ever
He will not break a bruised reed or quench a smoldering wick
2027-07-17.verse: A bruised reed he will not break, and a dimly burning wick he will not quench; he will faithfully bring forth justice.

2027-07-19.title: Monday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Do not be afraid, stand firm, and see the deliverance that the Lord will accomplish for you today
I will sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously
Something greater than Jonah is here
2027-07-19.verse: But Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid, stand firm, and see the deliverance that the Lord will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians whom you see today you shall never see again. The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to keep still.”

2027-07-20.title: Tuesday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Apollinaris
readings: The Israelites went into the sea on dry ground, the waters forming a wall for them
Sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously
Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother
2027-07-20.verse: The Israelites went into the sea on dry ground, the waters forming a wall for them on their right and on their left.

2027-07-21.title: Wednesday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Lawrence of Brindisi
readings: I am going to rain bread from heaven for you
The Lord gave them bread from heaven
Other seeds fell on good soil and brought forth grain
2027-07-21.verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “I am going to rain bread from heaven for you, and each day the people shall go out and gather enough for that day.

2027-07-22.title: Saint Mary Magdalene
readings: I sought him whom my soul loves; I held him and would not let him go
My soul is thirsting for you, O Lord my God
Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”
2027-07-22.verse: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”; and she told them that he had said these things to her.

2027-07-23.title: Friday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Bridget of Sweden
readings: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Lord, you have the words of everlasting life
The seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it
2027-07-23.verse: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; you shall have no other gods before me.

2027-07-24.title: Saturday of the Sixteenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Sharbel Makhluf
readings: See the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you
To the upright I will show the saving power of God
Let both of them grow together until the harvest
2027-07-24.verse: Then he took the book of the covenant, and read it in the hearing of the people; and they said, “All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.” Moses took the blood and dashed it on the people, and said, “See the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words.”

2027-07-26.title: Saints Joachim and Anne, Parents of the Blessed Virgin Mary
readings: Alas, this people has sinned a great sin; they have made for themselves gods of gold
Remember us, O Lord, as you favor your people
The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed ... like yeast
2027-07-26.verse: Their bodies are buried in peace, but their name lives on generation after generation. The assembly declares their wisdom, and the congregation proclaims their praise.

2027-07-27.title: Tuesday of the Seventeenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: The Lord used to speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend
The Lord is kind and merciful
Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field
2027-07-27.verse: The Lord passed before him, and proclaimed, “The Lord, the Lord, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness

2027-07-28.title: Saint Alphonsa of the Immaculate Conception, Virgin
readings: Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God
Holy is the Lord our God
In his joy he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field
2027-07-28.verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai. As he came down from the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand, Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God.

2027-07-29.title: Saints Martha, Mary and Lazarus
readings: The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle
How lovely is your dwelling place, Lord, mighty God
I am the resurrection and the life
2027-07-29.verse: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live, and everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

2027-07-30.title: Friday of the Seventeenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Peter Chrysologus
readings: These are the appointed festivals of the Lord, the holy convocations
Sing with joy to God our help
Prophets are not without honor except in their own country and in their own house
2027-07-30.verse: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, “Prophets are not without honor except in their own country and in their own house.” And he did not do many deeds of power there, because of their unbelief.

2027-07-31.title: Saint Ignatius of Loyola, Priest
readings: In this year of jubilee you shall return, every one of you, to your property
O God, let all the nations praise you!
Herod sent and had John beheaded in the prison
2027-07-31.verse: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year and you shall proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you: you shall return, every one of you, to your property and every one of you to your family.

kidsaint: St Thomas and the king's palace (a story from the old Acts of Thomas)
